name: Kanpeki Seitokaichou no Himitsu no Seiheki ~Takane no Hana no Kanojo o M-jo ni Kaika Saseteyaru~
original_name: 完璧生徒会長の秘密の性癖 ～高嶺の花の彼女をＭ女に開花させてやる～
source:
“I like you! Please go out with me!”

Standing right in front of him was Sorayume Sae, the student council president and the most beautiful girl in the school—so stunning that no amount of praise could do her justice.
Well, this is it. I’m done for, he thought… but to his surprise, she said yes!
And the very next day, they were off on a date to the amusement park!

(Sae’s my girlfriend now. So, of course, it’s only natural that we’d…!)

Drawn in by her mesmerizing lips, Hiromu leaned closer, his face inching toward hers.
But then…

“We’ve only just started dating, you know.
These kinds of things should happen after we’ve spent more time together, gotten to know each other better, and built a proper connection. So, let’s take it slow, okay?”

Or so she said, but somehow, they ended up at a hotel anyway…

“Listen, we’ve only been dating for one day.”
“Time doesn’t matter. It’s about how we feel, right?”
“W-well, yes, feelings are important. Fine, I’ll admit—even if it’s just one day after starting to date, physical intimacy can happen. But… but this?! What on earth is this supposed to be?!”

There was nothing strange about the situation.
Using a rope he found lying around, he’d tied up the beautiful girl, creating the most adorable and risqué sight he’d ever dreamed of.

“You’re tied up with rope, emphasizing your chest and other… important areas. It’s the perfect look. What’s wrong with it?”
“That’s the problem! Who in the world ties someone up with rope the moment they step into a hotel?!”

And so, the two of them continued on their… unique path.

“我喜欢你！请和我交往！”

站在他面前的是天梦冴依，学生会长，也是学校最美丽的女孩，美得无论怎样称赞都不为过。
“完了，我死定了。”他心想……没想到，她竟然答应了！
第二天，两人便一起去了游乐园约会。

“冴依现在是我的女朋友了。那当然应该……”

弘梦被她迷人的嘴唇吸引，慢慢靠近她的脸。
但就在这时——

“我们才刚开始交往吧。这样的事情，应该等我们相处更久、彼此更了解、建立真正的关系之后再做。所以，慢慢来，好吗？”

她嘴上这样说，两人却不知为何来到了酒店……

“听我说，我们才交往一天。”
“时间并不重要，重要的是我们的感情，对吧？”
“呃，没错，感情很重要。好吧，我承认——即使只交往了一天，也可能发生亲密行为。但是……但是这个又算什么？！”

眼前的情况并没有什么奇怪之处。
他拿起随手找到的绳子，把美丽女孩绑了起来，创造出自己梦寐以求的可爱又色情的景象。

“用绳子把你绑起来，凸显胸部和其他……重要部位。这不是很完美吗？有什么问题？”
“问题就在这里！谁会刚进酒店就用绳子把人绑起来啊！”

于是，两人继续走上了属于他们的……独特道路。
